body:
Closing this epic: all 12 checklist items are closed — #266 #267 #268 #269 #270 #271 #272 #273 #274 #275 #276 #277.

Verified by reading each child's state directly, not by the checklist boxes (which were never ticked by the workflow that closed the children). This epic carries no acceptance criteria outside its checklist, so nothing remains tracked here.
